visual_fit.media_size: PASS - 3.5-inch: rigid square shell, label printed '2HD' and '1.44' (1.44 MB high-density 3.5-inch format), slot width matches disk. Not 5.25-inch or 8-inch (no flexible sleeve, no large hub hole/oval head window).
visual_fit.drive_type: PASS - single narrow horizontal slot, rectangular push-button eject at the right end, small indicator window at the left; no 5.25-inch rotating latch lever. Consistent with a 3.5-inch drive. Exact drive model not identified.
visual_fit.insertion_direction: PASS with caveat - label side faces up on a flat-lying (horizontal) drive. The metal shutter itself is not visible in any sampled frame (already inside the slot or blurred by 1.0-1.5 s). The trailing edge at 2.2 s shows the corner holes that on a 3.5-inch disk sit on the edge opposite the shutter, so the shutter end is inferred to lead. Direction is therefore inferred from the trailing edge, not directly observed.
visual_fit.hand_and_disk_in_frame: PASS during 00:01.00-00:03.00; hold 00:03.00-00:06.00 shows the inserted disk with no hand.
visual_fit.composition: Drive lies diagonally across frame (camera angled), shallow depth of field, warm practical light flare upper right. Bare drive on metal plate, not installed in a PC.
visual_fit.captions_watermarks: None seen in sampled frames (player controls are page UI, not baked in).
visual_fit.narration_audio: Not checked (preview muted/seeked; audio track not inspected).
